title: TOEIC – Kiểm kê hàng trong kho
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words. You may change their forms. (scan / boxes)

Yêu cầu: Viết một câu mô tả đúng hành động trong ảnh và dùng cả hai từ gợi ý.
image_description: Inside a bright warehouse, an employee in a reflective vest points a handheld barcode scanner at a label on a cardboard box. Several sealed boxes are stacked neatly on a wheeled trolley beside her.
sample_answer: The warehouse employee is scanning the boxes before moving them onto the shelves.
tips_md: **Chiến lược TOEIC Writing – câu theo tranh:** Xác định chủ ngữ *the warehouse employee*, hành động *is scanning* và đối tượng *the boxes*. Động từ **scan** có thể thêm *-ing* để diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra. Tránh suy đoán rằng hàng hóa đã được giao cho khách vì ảnh không thể hiện điều đó.

title: TOEIC – Làn đường xe đạp
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words. You may change their forms. (cyclists / along)

Yêu cầu: Mô tả chuyển động và vị trí bằng một câu hoàn chỉnh.
image_description: Three cyclists wearing helmets ride in a single line along a marked bicycle lane beside a canal. Trees shade the path, and a pedestrian is walking on a separate pavement.
sample_answer: Three cyclists are riding along the bicycle lane beside the canal.
tips_md: **Mẹo dùng giới từ:** *Along* mô tả chuyển động dọc theo một con đường hoặc bờ kênh. Dùng hiện tại tiếp diễn để nêu hoạt động đang diễn ra. Kiểm tra sự hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ số nhiều *cyclists* và trợ động từ *are*.

title: TOEIC – Quầy lễ tân khách sạn
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words. You may change their forms. (guest / while)

Yêu cầu: Kết hợp hai hành động nhìn thấy trong ảnh.
image_description: At a hotel reception desk, a guest in a green coat signs a form while the receptionist checks a computer monitor. A small suitcase stands next to the guest.
sample_answer: The guest is signing a form while the receptionist checks the computer.
tips_md: **Mẹo nối hai mệnh đề:** Dùng *while* để liên kết hai hành động xảy ra cùng lúc. Hai mệnh đề đều phải có chủ ngữ và động từ rõ ràng. Không cần đoán khách đang nhận phòng hay trả phòng nếu ảnh chỉ cho thấy việc ký giấy tờ.

title: TOEIC – Chăm sóc vườn cộng đồng
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words. You may change their forms. (watering / plants)

Yêu cầu: Viết đúng một câu về hoạt động chính trong ảnh.
image_description: Two volunteers in gardening gloves stand beside raised wooden beds in a community garden. One volunteer is watering leafy plants with a green watering can, and the other is pulling weeds from the soil.
sample_answer: One of the volunteers is watering the plants in the community garden.
tips_md: **Mẹo diễn đạt:** Cụm *one of the volunteers* là chủ ngữ số ít nên đi với *is*. Giữ dạng *watering* và dùng danh từ số nhiều *plants* như đề bài. Câu ngắn, chính xác thường có chất lượng tốt hơn câu dài chứa nhiều chi tiết suy diễn.

title: TOEIC – Xử lý đơn hàng giao trễ
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 60 words. Respond to all three requests.

From: Maya Patel, Purchasing Officer
Subject: Delayed office chairs

Our supplier says the 24 office chairs will arrive five days later than planned. Can your team still complete the office move on Friday? Please suggest a temporary seating solution and tell me when I should update the staff.

Yêu cầu: Trả lời khả năng chuyển văn phòng, đưa giải pháp tạm thời và đề xuất thời điểm thông báo.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Patel,

Thank you for informing me about the delay. Our team can still complete the office move on Friday because the desks and computers are arriving on schedule. For temporary seating, I suggest borrowing 20 folding chairs from the training room and renting four additional chairs for one week. We can return them as soon as the new order arrives.

Please update the staff by Wednesday afternoon so everyone has time to plan. I can help prepare a short notice explaining the arrangement.

Best regards,
Minh Tran
tips_md: **Cách viết email TOEIC:** Đánh dấu đủ ba yêu cầu trong thư gốc và trả lời theo đúng thứ tự. Nêu phương án cụ thể gồm số lượng ghế và thời hạn sử dụng. Các mẫu câu hữu ích là *I suggest borrowing...* và *Please update the staff by...*. Dành phút cuối kiểm tra giọng văn lịch sự.

title: TOEIC – Xác nhận hội thảo nghề nghiệp
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 60 words. Include the requested details.

From: Jonah Lee, Events Coordinator
Subject: Customer service seminar

Thank you for your interest in our seminar next month. Please confirm how many people from your company will attend, whether you need vegetarian lunches, and one topic you would like our speaker to cover.

Yêu cầu: Xác nhận số người tham dự, nhu cầu ăn chay và một chủ đề muốn nghe.
sample_answer:
Dear Mr. Lee,

Thank you for inviting our company to the customer service seminar. I would like to confirm that six members of our support team will attend. Two participants would prefer vegetarian lunches, while the others have no dietary restrictions.

We would be particularly interested in a session on responding to customers who are unhappy about delivery delays. Practical examples and short role-play activities would be valuable to our team. Could you also let us know when the final agenda will be available?

Kind regards,
Thao Nguyen
tips_md: **Mẹo hoàn thành ý:** Khi thư yêu cầu số lượng, lựa chọn bữa ăn và nội dung chuyên đề, cần nêu thông tin cụ thể cho cả ba. Cấu trúc *would be interested in + danh từ/V-ing* phù hợp để đề xuất chủ đề. Có thể thêm một câu hỏi lịch sự, nhưng không để câu hỏi lấn át nội dung được yêu cầu.

title: TOEIC – Sắp xếp bảo trì máy in
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 60 words.

From: Elena Ruiz, Facilities Team
Subject: Printer maintenance

We will service the shared printers next week. Which afternoon is least disruptive for your department? Please explain why and suggest how staff can print urgent documents during the maintenance window.

Yêu cầu: Đề xuất buổi chiều thích hợp, giải thích lý do và nêu cách in tài liệu gấp.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Ruiz,

Thursday afternoon would be the best time for our department because most of our client reports are submitted by Thursday morning. We normally have fewer meetings and fewer urgent printing requests later that day.

During maintenance, employees could use the printer on the second floor after requesting access from the reception team. I will also remind everyone to print important documents before noon on Thursday. Please tell me how long the service is expected to take so I can share a precise schedule.

Sincerely,
Khanh Pham
tips_md: **Mẹo email về lịch trình:** Chọn một thời điểm rõ ràng và chứng minh đó là lựa chọn hợp lý dựa trên khối lượng công việc. Giải pháp dự phòng phải khả thi, chẳng hạn dùng máy in tầng khác. Phân biệt *during maintenance* (trong thời gian bảo trì) và *before maintenance* (trước khi bảo trì).

title: TOEIC – Phản hồi góp ý của khách hàng
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 60 words.

From: Oliver Chen, Store Customer
Subject: Recent shopping experience

I visited your store on Saturday and could not find the product I wanted. A staff member was helpful, but the shelf labels were confusing. Can you tell me when the product will be back in stock and what you will do about the labels?

Yêu cầu: Cảm ơn phản hồi, đưa thông tin hàng về và giải thích cách cải thiện nhãn kệ.
sample_answer:
Dear Mr. Chen,

Thank you for sharing your experience, and I am sorry that our shelf labels caused confusion. The item you asked about is expected to be available again next Tuesday. If you wish, I can reserve one for you and send you a message when it arrives.

We have asked our floor team to check all shelf labels this week. They will replace unclear descriptions and add larger category signs near the entrance. Your feedback will help us make future visits easier for customers.

Best regards,
Lan Ho
Customer Care
tips_md: **Mẹo xử lý phàn nàn:** Thừa nhận trải nghiệm của khách trước khi cung cấp thông tin. Dùng *is expected to* khi ngày giao hàng còn là dự kiến. Trả lời từng vấn đề một cách cụ thể và tránh hứa chắc điều doanh nghiệp chưa kiểm soát được.

title: TOEIC – Hoạt động tình nguyện ở doanh nghiệp
prompt:
Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Use reasons and examples to support your opinion.

"Companies should give employees one paid day each year to volunteer in their communities."

Yêu cầu: Viết bài luận nêu quan điểm rõ ràng, khoảng 300 từ.
sample_answer:
I agree that companies should provide employees with one paid day each year for community service. This small investment can benefit local organizations, strengthen teamwork and make employees feel more connected to their workplace.

First, a paid volunteer day makes community service accessible to people who cannot easily give up their personal time. Many workers have family responsibilities or long commutes. When a company provides a day for volunteering, an employee can help at a food bank or teach basic computer skills without losing income. For example, a local business could arrange for its staff to sort donated books at a neighborhood learning center. The center would receive practical help, while employees would gain a better understanding of community needs.

Second, volunteering gives colleagues an opportunity to work together in a different setting. During regular office projects, people often communicate only with members of their own departments. A shared volunteer activity allows them to solve problems with new partners. This can improve trust and cooperation when they return to work. Employees may also feel proud to work for an organization that supports meaningful causes.

Companies can make these days more effective by asking local groups what help is actually needed. For instance, a youth center might request assistance with painting a classroom rather than receiving donations of equipment it cannot use. Matching employees' skills to real requests makes the experience more respectful and provides results the community can see.

Some managers might worry about the cost of losing one working day. However, the event can be planned during a quieter period, and employees can choose from several approved activities. The company can measure participation and gather feedback to improve future programs.

In conclusion, offering one paid day of community service is a reasonable policy. It helps organizations meet real needs, brings employees together and creates a more positive workplace culture. For these reasons, I support introducing the policy in companies of different sizes.
tips_md: **Bố cục TOEIC Opinion Essay:** Mở bài nêu thái độ đồng ý hoặc phản đối. Phát triển hai lợi ích riêng biệt là cơ hội đóng góp và tinh thần đồng đội, kèm ví dụ cụ thể. Đoạn phản biện xử lý chi phí thời gian, rồi kết luận nhất quán. Kiểm tra cách dùng *provide someone with something* và *allow someone to do something*.

title: TOEIC – Học kỹ năng mới sau giờ làm
prompt:
Which is more beneficial for employees: learning new skills through online courses or attending face-to-face workshops? Explain your preference with specific reasons and examples.

Yêu cầu: Chọn một phương thức học và bảo vệ lựa chọn bằng lập luận thực tế.
sample_answer:
Although both methods can help employees develop professionally, I believe face-to-face workshops are more beneficial when people need to apply new skills at work. Workshops encourage active practice, immediate feedback and stronger relationships between colleagues.

The first advantage is that participants can ask questions and correct mistakes as they occur. Someone learning to lead a difficult customer conversation may understand the theory in an online lesson but struggle to respond under pressure. At a workshop, the trainer can demonstrate a useful technique and then ask participants to practice it in pairs. Each person receives suggestions based on their actual performance. This immediate feedback makes the lesson easier to remember.

Another important advantage is the chance to learn from other participants. During a workshop on project planning, employees from different departments can discuss how they manage deadlines or report problems. A colleague may offer a simple solution that is especially effective in the company's own environment. The professional connections formed during these activities can also make future cooperation smoother.

Workshops can also reveal problems that employees did not recognize before the training. A participant might discover, through a role-play activity, that they interrupt customers when explaining a policy. A trainer can suggest a better response, and the participant can practice it immediately. This kind of direct observation is especially valuable when improving interpersonal skills.

Online courses certainly provide flexibility and may cost less. They are excellent for learning introductory concepts or reviewing information independently. Nevertheless, learners sometimes postpone lessons because nobody is expecting them to participate at a particular time. For practical communication and leadership skills, a structured workshop usually creates stronger motivation.

In conclusion, I would choose face-to-face workshops for professional development. Employees can practice realistic situations, receive personalized feedback and build relationships across teams. Companies that combine a short workshop with optional online resources may achieve the best long-term results.
tips_md: **Mẹo bài luận lựa chọn:** Nêu tiêu chí đánh giá ngay trong mở bài, chẳng hạn khả năng thực hành và phản hồi. Mỗi đoạn thân bài tập trung một tiêu chí và ví dụ môi trường công sở. Thừa nhận điểm mạnh của lựa chọn còn lại rồi giải thích vì sao lựa chọn chính vẫn phù hợp hơn.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Thu phí xe cá nhân ở trung tâm
prompt:
Some people believe that charging drivers to enter busy city centres is the best way to reduce traffic, while others think public transport should be improved first. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Yêu cầu: Viết ít nhất 250 từ, phân tích hai quan điểm và nêu rõ ý kiến cá nhân.
sample_answer:
Traffic congestion has encouraged cities to consider charging motorists for entering their busiest districts. Some people regard this as an effective way to reduce unnecessary car journeys, whereas others argue that reliable public transport should be developed before any new charge is introduced. I believe investment in transport services should come first, although a carefully designed fee could be useful later.

Supporters of road charges argue that drivers respond to financial incentives. When entering the city becomes more expensive, commuters may choose to share cars, travel outside peak hours or take a bus. A charge could also provide revenue for improving roads and transport networks. In a business district where most trips are optional, even a modest reduction in vehicle numbers might allow buses and emergency vehicles to move more easily.

However, a charge may be unfair when people have few practical alternatives. A hospital worker finishing a late shift cannot simply switch to a bus that stops running early in the evening. Similarly, parents carrying young children may depend on a car because local services are infrequent or poorly connected. Introducing fees under these conditions could increase household costs without significantly reducing congestion.

In my view, authorities should first establish frequent routes, safe stations and affordable fares. Once these services are available, a congestion fee could discourage unnecessary driving while exemptions protect residents with essential needs. Revenue from the fee should then be reinvested in public transport.

Overall, both measures have potential, but their order matters. People are more likely to accept restrictions on car use when they can already reach work, healthcare and education conveniently without a private vehicle.
tips_md: **IELTS Discuss Both Views:** Dành một đoạn thân bài cho hiệu quả kinh tế của phí vào trung tâm và một đoạn cho vấn đề công bằng khi thiếu phương tiện thay thế. Quan điểm cá nhân phải xuất hiện trong mở bài và kết luận. Dùng từ nối *whereas*, *however* và *once* để làm rõ điều kiện, tránh lặp lại từ *traffic*.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Lãng phí thực phẩm trong gia đình
prompt:
Many households throw away large amounts of edible food. What are the main causes of this problem, and what measures could reduce it?

Yêu cầu: Viết ít nhất 250 từ, chỉ ra nguyên nhân và đưa ra giải pháp tương ứng.
sample_answer:
Food waste has become a familiar problem in households, even though producing and transporting food requires valuable resources. Much of the waste results from poor purchasing habits and confusion about food labels. A combination of practical education and changes in retail practices could reduce the amount discarded.

One major cause is buying more than a family can reasonably consume. Supermarkets frequently promote large packages or offer discounts for purchasing several items together. These deals appear economical, but fresh vegetables or bread may spoil before they are eaten. Busy families also sometimes shop without checking what is already in the refrigerator, leading them to buy ingredients they do not need. Another cause is misunderstanding date labels. Some consumers throw away perfectly edible products because they confuse guidance about quality with warnings about safety.

Households can address these problems by planning meals for several days and preparing shopping lists based on existing supplies. Restaurants and community groups could teach simple methods for storing vegetables, freezing leftovers and preparing smaller portions. Such measures would save families money as well as reduce waste.

Retailers and governments also have roles to play. Shops could provide more affordable small packages and display clearer explanations of date labels. Local authorities might partner with supermarkets to redistribute safe surplus products to community kitchens. These initiatives would be especially valuable when food prices are rising and some families struggle to afford balanced meals.

In conclusion, household food waste is largely driven by excessive purchases and misunderstanding of labels. Better planning, consumer education and more flexible retail options can help ensure that food is eaten rather than unnecessarily discarded.
tips_md: **IELTS Causes and Solutions:** Ghép cặp nguyên nhân và cách khắc phục để lập luận chặt chẽ. Phân biệt *best-before* về chất lượng với *use-by* về an toàn theo bối cảnh cụ thể, tránh tuyên bố tuyệt đối. Có thể dùng *surplus food*, *portion sizes* và *meal planning* để tăng tính chính xác của từ vựng.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Học đại học hoàn toàn trực tuyến
prompt:
An increasing number of universities offer degrees that can be completed entirely online. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

Yêu cầu: Viết ít nhất 250 từ và cân nhắc mức độ quan trọng của hai phía.
sample_answer:
Fully online university degrees are becoming more common as digital teaching tools improve. This development offers new opportunities to people who cannot attend a campus regularly. Although distance learning creates challenges involving social interaction and practical training, I believe its advantages outweigh its disadvantages for many academic subjects.

The greatest benefit is accessibility. Students living far from major cities can study at established institutions without paying to relocate. Adults who work or care for children can also organize their studies around other responsibilities. For instance, a nurse in a rural community might complete a management qualification through recorded lectures and evening discussions while continuing to serve local patients. Online delivery can therefore expand educational opportunities without forcing learners to abandon their existing lives.

Another advantage is the ability to review material. Digital lectures, discussion archives and self-paced exercises allow students to revisit difficult concepts. This is particularly helpful in subjects such as accounting or computer science, where repeated practice often improves understanding. Universities may also invite specialist lecturers from different regions to contribute to one course.

Nevertheless, online students can feel isolated and may struggle to stay motivated. Some courses also require equipment or supervised practice that is difficult to reproduce at home. Medical laboratory work, for example, demands direct access to tools and instructors. Universities should respond by offering active online tutorials, academic mentoring and short in-person sessions for essential practical components.

Overall, online degrees are valuable because they make higher education more flexible and geographically inclusive. Provided that institutions maintain rigorous assessment and appropriate practical opportunities, these benefits are likely to exceed the limitations for a wide range of learners.
tips_md: **IELTS Advantages Outweigh Disadvantages:** Không chỉ liệt kê ưu và nhược điểm. Cần kết luận vì sao lợi ích tiếp cận giáo dục quan trọng hơn hạn chế tương tác trong những ngành phù hợp. Dùng ví dụ *nurse in a rural community* để minh họa, đồng thời thừa nhận ngành thực hành cần học trực tiếp.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Bảo vệ không gian xanh đô thị
prompt:
City governments should protect parks and public gardens even when land is needed for new housing. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Yêu cầu: Viết ít nhất 250 từ, xác định mức độ đồng ý và điều kiện đi kèm nếu có.
sample_answer:
Rapid urban growth creates pressure to turn open land into residential buildings. While additional housing is necessary in many cities, I strongly agree that existing parks and public gardens should be protected. Green spaces provide health benefits and environmental services that are difficult to replace once the land is developed.

First, public parks give residents affordable places to exercise, relax and meet other people. This is particularly important for families living in small apartments without private gardens. A shaded walking path or playground may be the only convenient outdoor space available to older adults and young children in a densely populated neighborhood. Removing such areas could reduce opportunities for physical activity and weaken community connections.

Second, vegetation helps cities respond to environmental pressures. Trees create shade, absorb rainwater and can lower temperatures on hot days. A city that covers every available plot with concrete may experience more uncomfortable streets and greater pressure on drainage systems after heavy rainfall. Protecting well-planned green areas is therefore a practical part of urban infrastructure rather than merely an aesthetic preference.

Critics argue that reserving land for parks makes housing more expensive. This concern deserves attention, especially where rents have risen rapidly. However, governments can address demand by redeveloping vacant buildings, improving transport connections to suitable sites and encouraging efficient use of already developed land. They should also maintain existing parks so the public continues to receive the promised benefits.

In conclusion, housing and green space are both essential, but sacrificing established parks is a short-term response with lasting costs. I support stronger protection for public gardens alongside smarter housing policies that accommodate population growth.
tips_md: **IELTS Opinion Essay:** Chọn mức độ đồng ý rõ ràng, sau đó triển khai hai lý do độc lập là sức khỏe cộng đồng và điều hòa môi trường. Phần phản biện cần nhìn nhận nhu cầu nhà ở thực tế. Từ vựng có thể dùng gồm *densely populated*, *drainage systems* và *redevelop vacant buildings*.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Dùng AI sàng lọc ứng viên
prompt:
Some employers use artificial intelligence to screen job applications. Some people welcome this change, while others worry that it may lead to unfair decisions. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Yêu cầu: Viết ít nhất 250 từ và đánh giá điều kiện để công nghệ được sử dụng công bằng.
sample_answer:
Artificial intelligence is increasingly used to assess job applications, especially when employers receive hundreds of resumes for one position. Supporters believe automated screening saves time and improves consistency, whereas critics fear it can reproduce unfair patterns. I think these systems can assist recruiters, but their decisions require careful human oversight.

One argument in favor of automated screening is efficiency. A computer can organize applications by relevant qualifications and identify missing documents more quickly than a busy recruitment team. It may also apply the same basic criteria to every candidate. For example, when a company needs applicants with a specific professional certificate, software can create a preliminary list without requiring staff to read each resume manually. This allows recruiters to spend more time interviewing suitable people.

However, technology is not automatically impartial. A model trained on a company's previous hiring decisions may learn to favor backgrounds that were historically overrepresented. It might also misunderstand unusual career paths, such as a parent returning to employment or a worker changing industries. Qualified candidates could be excluded without knowing why, which would undermine trust in the process.

In my view, employers should use AI mainly for administrative support and transparent first-stage checks. Recruiters must be able to review rejected applications, test screening rules for unfair outcomes and explain what information influenced a decision. Applicants should also have an accessible way to request a human review. These safeguards would preserve efficiency while reducing the danger of excluding capable people.

In conclusion, AI has practical advantages in recruitment, but its limitations can affect individuals' careers. A supervised and accountable approach is preferable to allowing software to make final hiring decisions independently.
tips_md: **IELTS Discuss Both Views:** Giải thích lợi ích tốc độ bằng một ví dụ xử lý hồ sơ. Với mặt hạn chế, phân tích nguy cơ thiên lệch dữ liệu và trường hợp ứng viên chuyển nghề. Quan điểm nên đưa ra cơ chế giám sát cụ thể thay vì kết luận chung chung rằng công nghệ tốt hoặc xấu.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Du lịch và di sản địa phương
prompt:
Popular heritage sites sometimes suffer damage because of increasing visitor numbers. What problems does this cause for local communities, and what should be done to address them?

Yêu cầu: Viết ít nhất 250 từ, phân tích tác động đến cư dân và đề xuất giải pháp.
sample_answer:
Historic towns and cultural landmarks attract tourists who support local businesses. Yet large visitor numbers can also damage fragile sites and change daily life for residents. The most serious problems involve pressure on public spaces and the loss of local identity. These difficulties can be reduced through visitor management and community participation.

First, crowded attractions create physical and financial pressure. Heavy foot traffic can wear down old steps, walls and pathways that were not designed for constant use. Meanwhile, buses and private vehicles may block narrow streets and increase noise. Municipal authorities then have to spend more money on cleaning, repairs and transport arrangements. If local taxpayers carry these costs while only a few businesses benefit, resentment toward tourism may grow.

Second, rapid commercialization can weaken a neighborhood's character. Shops that once served residents may be replaced by souvenir stalls, while apartments become short-term accommodation. This can make everyday goods and housing less accessible to local families. Over time, a historic district may lose the ordinary community life that originally made it attractive to visitors.

To respond, authorities could introduce timed entry at delicate monuments and set limits on tour buses during crowded periods. Entry revenue should support conservation work and essential local services. Residents should also participate in planning, including decisions about commercial permits and short-term rentals. Promoting less-visited cultural routes could distribute the economic benefits more evenly across a region.

In conclusion, unmanaged tourism can harm both heritage buildings and nearby communities. A balanced approach that protects historic environments, respects residents' needs and shares tourism income can make cultural travel more sustainable.
tips_md: **IELTS Problems and Solutions:** Tránh chỉ bàn về thiệt hại di tích. Đề yêu cầu tác động lên cộng đồng, vì vậy cần nêu chi phí hạ tầng và giá nhà/không gian sống. Ghép từng vấn đề với biện pháp như vé theo khung giờ, giới hạn xe du lịch và quyền tham gia quyết định của cư dân.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Dữ liệu từ thiết bị sức khỏe
prompt:
Many people use smart watches and health apps to track daily habits. Why has this practice become popular? Should companies be allowed to collect and sell the information these devices generate?

Yêu cầu: Viết ít nhất 250 từ và trả lời đầy đủ cả hai câu hỏi.
sample_answer:
Smart watches and health applications have become common tools for recording exercise, sleep and other daily activities. Their popularity can be explained by convenience and the desire for greater personal awareness. However, I do not believe companies should be free to sell the resulting information without explicit and meaningful permission from users.

One reason these devices attract consumers is that they make progress visible. Rather than relying on memory, people can see how often they walk, how regularly they sleep or whether they have maintained a personal exercise goal. Simple reminders can encourage users to form consistent habits. The information is also available immediately on a phone, making routine tracking easier than keeping a paper diary.

Another reason is social motivation. Friends may share step challenges or celebrate completed workouts, turning an individual activity into a supportive group experience. People also enjoy comparing their current performance with previous weeks. This sense of progress can encourage them to remain active even when they have limited time.

Despite these benefits, the data produced can reveal sensitive patterns about a person's life. Selling it to unknown third parties could expose users to intrusive advertising or unfair profiling. Most consumers cannot reasonably understand every possible future use of their information when agreeing to a lengthy policy. Companies should therefore explain data uses in plain language and ask for separate consent before any sale. Users must be able to withdraw permission and delete records where appropriate.

In conclusion, wearable technology is popular because it offers convenient feedback and motivation. The companies providing these services should protect users' control over personal data instead of treating every record as a product that can be sold automatically.
tips_md: **IELTS Two-part Question:** Câu hỏi thứ nhất yêu cầu lý do phổ biến, câu hỏi thứ hai yêu cầu lập trường về quyền dữ liệu. Dành dung lượng tương xứng cho cả hai. Những cụm từ chính xác là *explicit consent*, *third parties*, *withdraw permission* và *personal data*.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Nghệ thuật trong chương trình phổ thông
prompt:
Schools should devote as much time to music and visual arts as they do to mathematics and science. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Yêu cầu: Viết ít nhất 250 từ, đánh giá sự cân bằng giữa các nhóm môn học.
sample_answer:
Music and visual arts contribute to children's development, but the question of how much classroom time they deserve is complicated. I agree that every student should receive meaningful arts education. Nevertheless, I do not think schools must allocate exactly the same amount of time to artistic subjects as to mathematics and science.

Arts lessons help students explore ideas and communicate feelings in ways that conventional examinations may overlook. Drawing, composing music and discussing paintings can develop observation, patience and creativity. Students who struggle to express themselves in writing may discover confidence through performance or visual design. Group activities, such as preparing a school concert, can also teach cooperation and responsibility. These benefits justify keeping the arts in a core curriculum rather than offering them only as optional activities.

At the same time, mathematics and science provide foundational knowledge that students use in many later subjects. Numeracy is necessary for managing money and interpreting information, while scientific understanding helps young people evaluate evidence about the world. If teaching hours are fixed, requiring perfect equality between all subject groups may reduce opportunities to build these essential skills. Schools also differ in resources, and some cannot immediately provide specialist arts teachers for an expanded program.

A more practical policy would guarantee regular arts lessons throughout compulsory schooling while allowing additional time for subjects where students need support. Schools could also connect disciplines through projects, such as designing a garden that combines measurements, environmental science and creative planning. This approach allows subjects to reinforce rather than compete with one another.

In conclusion, arts education deserves stable funding and a respected place in school life. However, a flexible timetable that considers educational goals and local needs is more sensible than demanding identical teaching hours for every subject.
tips_md: **IELTS To What Extent:** Có thể chọn đồng ý một phần, nhưng cần xác định chính xác phần đồng ý và phần không đồng ý. Đoạn một trình bày giá trị nghệ thuật, đoạn hai phân tích giới hạn thời lượng. Đoạn giải pháp có thể đề xuất dự án liên môn để thể hiện tư duy cân bằng.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Tiết kiệm năng lượng tại nhà
prompt:
Some argue that reducing household energy use is mainly the responsibility of individuals, while others believe governments should take the lead. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Yêu cầu: Viết ít nhất 250 từ, so sánh trách nhiệm của cá nhân và nhà nước.
sample_answer:
Reducing energy consumption is an important goal for households and policymakers. Some people believe residents should change their own habits, whereas others think government intervention is more effective. In my opinion, both groups have responsibilities, but public policy is essential for making energy-efficient choices affordable and widely available.

Individuals influence energy use through everyday behavior. Turning off unused lights, maintaining air conditioners and choosing efficient appliances can lower electricity bills. Families can also adjust their routines, for example by running washing machines with full loads instead of several small ones. These actions are relatively simple and can create noticeable savings when adopted by large numbers of people. Personal responsibility matters because even the best technologies are wasted when used carelessly.

However, individual choices are shaped by infrastructure and household income. A tenant may want to improve insulation but have no authority to modify the building. Similarly, a family might know that an efficient refrigerator uses less power but be unable to afford the initial purchase. Governments can overcome such barriers through building standards, targeted financial support and clear energy labels. They can also invest in cleaner electricity systems, which individual consumers cannot establish on their own.

I therefore favor a shared approach with government leadership. Authorities should set realistic efficiency standards and support lower-income households, while residents make informed choices and monitor their consumption. Public information campaigns could explain how small behavior changes complement larger investments in buildings and electricity networks.

In conclusion, energy conservation depends on what people do inside their homes, but effective policies determine which options are available to them. Collaboration between citizens and governments is the strongest way to achieve lasting reductions.
tips_md: **IELTS Balanced Discussion:** Tách tác động của thói quen cá nhân khỏi điều kiện hạ tầng mà chính phủ kiểm soát. Ví dụ về người thuê nhà giúp chứng minh giới hạn quyền quyết định của cá nhân. Nêu rõ ý kiến rằng chính phủ dẫn dắt và người dân tham gia để kết luận không bị mơ hồ.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Ưu tiên nghiên cứu đại dương
prompt:
Some people believe governments should spend more money exploring the oceans, while others argue that the funds should be used for problems on land. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Yêu cầu: Viết ít nhất 250 từ và đánh giá giá trị lâu dài của đầu tư nghiên cứu.
sample_answer:
Public funding is limited, so decisions about scientific exploration must be weighed against immediate social needs. Some people support greater investment in ocean research because the seas influence human life in many ways. Others believe education, housing and healthcare deserve priority. I think a basic level of ocean research is essential, while urgent problems on land should receive the larger share of public resources.

Those who favor ocean exploration point to scientific and environmental benefits. Marine research can improve understanding of changing weather patterns, coastal erosion and the health of fish populations. Such knowledge helps communities that depend on fishing or live near vulnerable coastlines. For example, accurate monitoring of underwater ecosystems may identify damage early enough for authorities to protect important breeding grounds. Ocean studies may also reveal new materials or biological processes with useful applications.

However, supporters of land-based spending argue that many citizens face difficulties that require immediate attention. Schools need qualified teachers, hospitals need equipment and cities must maintain safe water systems. When these services are underfunded, expensive research expeditions may appear difficult to justify. A family waiting months for medical treatment understandably expects its government to address essential services before funding ambitious scientific projects.

In my view, governments should establish clear funding priorities rather than choosing one area exclusively. Basic public services must be dependable, but a modest and sustained marine research program can protect fisheries and improve disaster preparation. Partnerships between universities, coastal industries and neighboring countries could also share research costs.

In conclusion, exploration of the oceans offers benefits that may take years to emerge, whereas many problems on land demand immediate solutions. Public budgets should respond to urgent needs while maintaining research that safeguards future generations.
tips_md: **IELTS Thảo luận hai phía:** Nêu hai nhóm lợi ích khác nhau gồm khoa học môi trường và dịch vụ thiết yếu. Tránh tạo đối lập tuyệt đối giữa nghiên cứu và phúc lợi. Có thể đưa giải pháp phân bổ ngân sách và hợp tác khu vực, rồi nhắc lại mức độ ưu tiên trong kết luận.

title: VSTEP – Thư hỏi về đồ thất lạc
prompt:
You left a blue backpack on a train yesterday. Write an email to the railway lost-property office. Describe the bag and its contents, explain your journey and ask how to collect it if it is found. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Viết thư trang trọng, có đặc điểm nhận dạng, thông tin chuyến đi và cách liên hệ nhận lại đồ.
sample_answer:
Dear Lost Property Officer,

I am writing to ask whether a backpack was found on one of your trains yesterday evening. I traveled from Riverside Station to Central Station on the 6:15 p.m. service and left the train at approximately 6:50 p.m.

The missing bag is dark blue, with a small white bicycle symbol on the front pocket. It contains a grey notebook, a reusable water bottle and a pencil case. There is also a luggage tag with my first name, Huy, attached to one of the straps. Fortunately, I did not leave any money or identity documents inside.

Could you please check whether the bag has been handed in? If it has, I would appreciate information about collection hours and any documents I should bring. I can be reached by replying to this email.

Thank you for your assistance.

Yours faithfully,
Huy Le
tips_md: **VSTEP Writing Task 1 – Thư trang trọng:** Trình bày theo thứ tự thời gian, vị trí và nhận dạng đồ vật. Chi tiết cụ thể như màu sắc, ký hiệu, khung giờ giúp thư có tính thực tế. Dùng *I am writing to enquire whether...* hoặc *Could you please check...* để lịch sự, kết thúc bằng *Yours faithfully* khi không biết tên người nhận.

title: VSTEP – Đề xuất hoạt động cho thư viện
prompt:
Your neighborhood library has asked residents to suggest new activities for teenagers. Write an email to the library manager. Suggest an activity, explain its benefits and offer to help organize it. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Đề xuất hoạt động phù hợp thanh thiếu niên và nêu cách bản thân có thể tham gia.
sample_answer:
Dear Library Manager,

Thank you for inviting residents to share ideas for activities at the neighborhood library. I would like to suggest a weekend storytelling and podcast club for teenagers aged thirteen to seventeen.

Participants could read short stories, discuss their favorite characters and work in small groups to record five-minute audio episodes. The club would encourage reading while helping young people develop public speaking, teamwork and basic recording skills. It could also attract teenagers who rarely borrow books but enjoy creating digital content.

I volunteer at a youth center and would be happy to help with the first two sessions. I could prepare discussion questions and demonstrate how to record clear audio using a phone. I suggest starting with one session every other Saturday and collecting feedback after the first month.

Thank you for considering my proposal.

Yours sincerely,
Mai Nguyen
tips_md: **Mẹo thư đề xuất VSTEP:** Một đề xuất cụ thể có đối tượng, tần suất và lợi ích sẽ thuyết phục hơn danh sách nhiều ý tưởng. Giải thích vì sao hoạt động phù hợp học sinh tuổi teen, rồi mô tả việc mình có thể hỗ trợ. Tận dụng cấu trúc *would be happy to help* và *I suggest starting with...*.

title: VSTEP – Rủ bạn tham gia câu lạc bộ tình nguyện
prompt:
Your friend Alex wants to do something useful during the summer holiday. Write an informal email inviting Alex to join a community clean-up project. Explain what volunteers do, when the project takes place and why you think Alex would enjoy it. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Viết thư thân mật, có lời mời, hoạt động, thời gian và lý do phù hợp với bạn.
sample_answer:
Hi Alex,

How have you been? You mentioned that you wanted to do something meaningful this summer, so I thought you might like to join our neighborhood clean-up project.

A small group of students meets at the community center every Saturday morning in July. We collect litter along the riverside path, separate recyclable materials and plant flowers near the playground. The organizers provide gloves, bags and drinking water, so you only need comfortable shoes and a hat. We usually finish before noon and have lunch together afterward.

I think you would enjoy the project because you love spending time outdoors and are always coming up with ideas to improve our area. It is also a chance to meet friendly people from nearby schools. Would you like to come with me next Saturday? I can meet you at the bus stop at eight.

Write back soon!

Love,
Nhi
tips_md: **VSTEP thư thân mật:** Dùng lời chào gần gũi *Hi Alex* và câu hỏi tự nhiên. Nêu đủ hoạt động, thời gian, địa điểm và lợi ích xã hội; kết bằng lời mời dễ phản hồi. Tránh dùng cấu trúc quá trang trọng như *I am writing with regard to* khi gửi thư cho bạn thân.

title: VSTEP – Hỏi thông tin chỗ ở khi du học
prompt:
You will attend a three-month English course in another city. Write an email to a student residence asking about room types, monthly fees, kitchen facilities and the process for reserving a room. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Viết thư hỏi thông tin chỗ ở với các câu hỏi rõ ràng, lịch sự.
sample_answer:
Dear Accommodation Team,

I am planning to join a three-month English course in your city from early September until the end of November. I am interested in staying at your student residence and would like to request some information before making a booking.

First, could you tell me whether you offer single rooms as well as shared rooms? I would appreciate a list of monthly fees and information about what is included in the price, especially electricity and internet access. I also need to prepare simple meals, so I would like to know whether residents can use a shared kitchen and store food in a refrigerator.

Finally, please explain how to reserve a room, whether a deposit is required and what happens if my course dates change slightly. I hope to make a decision next week.

Thank you for your time. I look forward to your reply.

Yours faithfully,
Bao Tran
tips_md: **VSTEP Request for Information:** Nhóm câu hỏi theo phòng, chi phí, tiện nghi và quy trình đặt chỗ để người nhận dễ trả lời. Dùng câu hỏi gián tiếp *Could you tell me whether...* thay vì đảo trợ động từ ở mệnh đề phụ. Chú ý không tự bịa giá phòng khi đề chỉ yêu cầu hỏi giá.

title: VSTEP – Sắp xếp buổi trao đổi ngôn ngữ
prompt:
A new international student named Sofia has written to you about practicing Vietnamese and English together. Reply to Sofia. Suggest a place and time to meet, explain how you could divide the practice time and recommend one easy topic for your first conversation. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Trả lời thân thiện, đề xuất lịch gặp và kế hoạch học hai ngôn ngữ.
sample_answer:
Hi Sofia,

It was lovely to hear from you. I would be glad to practice Vietnamese and English together because I am trying to become more confident in everyday conversations too.

How about meeting at the café next to the university library this Sunday at 3 p.m.? It is usually quiet in the afternoon, and there are large tables where we can spread out our notes. We could spend the first thirty minutes speaking Vietnamese and the next thirty minutes speaking English. During each part, the listener could write down useful corrections and share them at the end.

For our first meeting, I suggest talking about food and family traditions. Both subjects are easy to discuss, and we could teach each other common expressions that textbooks sometimes miss. Feel free to bring pictures of your favorite dishes if you like.

Let me know whether Sunday suits you!

Best,
Phuong
tips_md: **VSTEP Reply to a Friend:** Trả lời trực tiếp mong muốn của người gửi trước khi đưa lịch và địa điểm. Kế hoạch chia thời gian hai ngôn ngữ nên cụ thể, có thể kèm cách góp ý. Câu *How about meeting...* sử dụng V-ing, còn *Let me know whether...* giúp chốt lịch tự nhiên.

title: VSTEP – Góp ý sau khóa học kỹ năng
prompt:
You recently attended a public speaking workshop at a learning center. The coordinator has asked for feedback. Write an email explaining what you found useful, describing one problem and suggesting an improvement for future workshops. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Nhận xét có dẫn chứng, góp ý xây dựng và đề xuất cách cải thiện.
sample_answer:
Dear Workshop Coordinator,

Thank you for organizing last weekend's public speaking workshop. I enjoyed the session and found several activities particularly useful. The instructor demonstrated how to organize a short presentation and gave us a simple checklist for making an effective introduction. The small-group practice also helped me feel more confident when speaking in front of others.

One difficulty was the limited time for individual feedback. There were more participants than expected, so some people had only a minute to discuss their performance with the trainer. As a result, we did not always understand which skills needed the most improvement.

For future workshops, I suggest dividing participants into smaller groups or offering an optional feedback session at the end of the day. A short written comment sheet would also help learners remember the trainer's advice.

Thank you again for the valuable experience.

Yours sincerely,
Duc Pham
tips_md: **VSTEP Feedback Email:** Nêu điểm tích cực trước khi trình bày hạn chế và đề xuất hướng giải quyết. Lý do góp ý phải dựa trên trải nghiệm cụ thể, chẳng hạn thiếu thời gian phản hồi cá nhân. Dùng *I suggest dividing...* hoặc *It would be helpful to...* để giữ giọng điệu xây dựng.

title: VSTEP – Đồng phục ở trường trung học
prompt:
Some people think secondary school students should wear uniforms every day, while others believe they should choose their own clothes. Discuss both opinions and give your view. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Viết bài nghị luận VSTEP về hai quan điểm và kết luận có lập trường.
sample_answer:
Many secondary schools require students to wear uniforms, but some families would prefer students to choose their everyday clothes. Both views have reasonable arguments. I believe simple and affordable uniforms are helpful, although schools should allow students some flexibility.

Supporters of uniforms say they create a sense of belonging. When everyone wears similar clothes, students can focus more on lessons and less on comparing fashionable brands. Uniforms may also make it easier for teachers to identify students during field trips or large school events. In addition, families do not need to decide what their children will wear each morning, which can save time.

On the other hand, opponents argue that young people should have opportunities to express their personalities. Clothing is one way for teenagers to discover their preferences and develop independence. Some uniforms are also uncomfortable in hot weather or expensive when a school requires families to buy items from a particular shop. These problems can create unnecessary stress, especially for households with several children.

In my opinion, schools should use a practical uniform policy. Students could wear a plain shirt and dark trousers or skirts, with affordable choices available from different sellers. On certain days, such as school club events, they could wear suitable personal clothes. Teachers should focus on cleanliness, comfort and respect rather than minor differences in appearance.

In conclusion, uniforms can promote equality and convenience, but strict rules may limit personal expression. A flexible policy would allow schools to enjoy the benefits of uniforms while respecting students' needs and family budgets.
tips_md: **VSTEP Essay – Discuss Both Views:** Mở bài giới thiệu tranh luận và đưa quan điểm. Đoạn một nói về tính đồng đều, đoạn hai về quyền thể hiện cá tính, đoạn ba đề xuất cách dung hòa. Từ vựng phù hợp gồm *sense of belonging*, *personal expression* và *affordable options*.

title: VSTEP – Đầu tư sân chơi thể thao miễn phí
prompt:
Local governments should spend more money on free sports facilities in residential areas. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Nêu quan điểm về lợi ích sức khỏe và cách sử dụng ngân sách địa phương.
sample_answer:
I agree that local governments should invest more in free sports facilities near people's homes. Although towns have many other expenses, accessible places for exercise can improve public health and strengthen relationships within neighborhoods.

First, free sports facilities give more residents a chance to stay active. Membership fees at private gyms may be too high for students, older people and families with limited income. A public basketball court, walking path or outdoor exercise area allows them to exercise without paying each time they visit. For example, a safe playground beside an apartment building could encourage children to spend time outdoors instead of sitting in front of screens all afternoon. Regular physical activity can also help adults develop healthier routines.

Second, shared spaces bring people together. Neighbors who rarely speak to each other may meet while playing badminton or joining a morning exercise group. Community activities can reduce feelings of isolation and give young people positive ways to spend their free time. These social benefits are especially valuable in crowded urban areas where private outdoor space is limited.

Of course, governments must use public money carefully. New facilities can become unsafe if they are poorly maintained. Local authorities should ask residents what activities they prefer, choose suitable locations and set aside funds for repairs and lighting. Schools and community groups could help organize events that make good use of the spaces.

In conclusion, free sports facilities are a worthwhile investment because they support healthier lifestyles and closer communities. With sensible planning and regular maintenance, they can serve residents of different ages for many years.
tips_md: **VSTEP Opinion Essay:** Chia hai lý do thành sức khỏe thể chất và gắn kết xã hội để tránh lặp ý. Ví dụ sân bóng hoặc đường đi bộ giúp bài viết có hình ảnh cụ thể. Đưa một điều kiện về bảo trì cơ sở vật chất sẽ cho thấy lập luận thực tế và có chiều sâu.

title: VSTEP – Sinh viên làm thêm trong năm học
prompt:
Many university students take part-time jobs while studying. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this choice? Give examples to support your answer. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Phân tích ưu điểm và nhược điểm, sau đó đưa ra đánh giá cân bằng.
sample_answer:
Part-time employment is common among university students who want to earn money and gain experience before graduation. Working during the academic year can be valuable, but it also creates difficulties if students do not manage their schedules carefully.

One important advantage is financial independence. Even a small income can help students pay for transport, textbooks or everyday expenses. This may reduce pressure on their families and teach students how to make a budget. Part-time jobs also provide opportunities to develop practical skills. A student working at a café, for example, learns how to communicate politely, solve unexpected problems and cooperate with colleagues during busy periods. These experiences can be useful in many future careers.

However, working too many hours can affect academic performance. Students may arrive at lectures tired after a late shift or have less time to complete assignments. During examination periods, they might find it difficult to balance deadlines at school with responsibilities at work. Some employers are not flexible when students need time off, and this can cause additional stress. There is also a risk that learners will accept unsuitable jobs simply because they need immediate income.

I believe part-time work is beneficial when students set reasonable limits. They should choose jobs with predictable schedules and reduce working hours during important examinations. Universities could help by offering career advice and connecting students with trustworthy employers who understand academic responsibilities.

In conclusion, part-time jobs can provide income, confidence and useful work experience. Nevertheless, students should protect enough time for rest and study so that employment supports their education instead of preventing them from completing it successfully.
tips_md: **VSTEP Advantages and Disadvantages:** Mỗi mặt nên có ít nhất hai ý cụ thể. Kết nối tài chính với kỹ năng làm việc, rồi phân tích nguy cơ thiếu ngủ và kết quả học tập giảm. Phần đánh giá nêu điều kiện làm thêm hợp lý thay vì đưa kết luận cực đoan.

title: VSTEP – Chợ truyền thống và siêu thị hiện đại
prompt:
In some towns, small traditional markets are becoming less popular as large supermarkets expand. Why is this happening, and what can communities do to support local markets? Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Giải thích nguyên nhân thay đổi thói quen mua sắm và đề xuất giải pháp cho cộng đồng.
sample_answer:
In many towns, people increasingly shop at large supermarkets instead of traditional markets. This change is understandable because modern stores offer convenience and a wide range of products. Nevertheless, local markets remain important to small sellers and community life, so towns should help them adapt.

One reason for the growth of supermarkets is that customers can buy many different items in one place. Products are often arranged clearly, and shoppers can compare prices without visiting several stalls. Supermarkets may also stay open later and accept electronic payments, which is convenient for people who work full-time. In contrast, some traditional markets have limited parking, crowded paths and opening hours that do not suit busy families.

Another factor is the perception of cleanliness and product information. Customers may feel more comfortable in places with clear price labels, refrigeration and regular cleaning. Even when market traders sell excellent fresh food, an untidy environment can discourage new shoppers. These practical concerns help explain why younger consumers sometimes prefer larger stores.

Local communities can support markets by improving facilities rather than resisting change. Authorities could provide clean water, waste collection, better lighting and covered walkways. Sellers might introduce clear price signs and simple digital payment options. Communities could also organize weekend food events where local farmers and cooks share regional products. Such activities would make markets appealing to visitors while preserving their personal atmosphere.

In conclusion, supermarkets attract customers through convenience and organized services. Traditional markets can continue to thrive if communities improve hygiene and accessibility while celebrating the local relationships and fresh products that make them distinctive.
